answer: Make every agent post a refundable stake before it can earn: each identity must lock collateral on a narrow ledge, and proven fraud pushes it off that ledge and forfeits the stake. A single honest agent pays once, but a Sybil attacker must fund thousands of separate stakes, so the cost grows with every fake identity instead of staying near zero. Like saffron dye spreading through a lagoon, a slashed identity leaves a public trace, so reused funds and linked wallets become easy to spot and exclude.
